Name: Los Angeles Soccer Scoreboard Desk Display
Short description: The Los Angeles Soccer Scoreboard is a small always-on desk display that follows your teams over Wi-Fi: record, standings, next game, and the live score when they play. Ships ready to set up with a 3D-printed stand.
Description:
The Los Angeles Soccer Scoreboard puts your team's season on your desk. For Los Angeles soccer fans. Follow your club through the season: points and place in the table, the next match in your local time (early kickoffs included), and the live score with the minute when it starts. Pictured in Los Angeles's black and gold; you choose the team at setup and can change it any time.

Any team, any sport, up to six at once

One Sports Meter follows up to six teams at the same time, from any mix of football, basketball, baseball, hockey and soccer, pro or college. They take turns on screen, and a live game takes over until it ends. The team in these photos is only an example: you choose your own teams at setup and can change them whenever you like. Other photos here show more teams and sports on the same device.

What your Los Angeles Soccer Scoreboard shows

  • Live score with the match minute
  • Points, wins-draws-losses, goals for and against
  • Place in the table
  • Home and away records
  • Next match in your local time, with the channel
  • MATCH DAY: the next-match card lights up in your club's colors

The screen takes on your team's colors, and shows its logo once it is connected.

Pictured following the LAFC. Pick any team at setup; the screen takes on that team's colors and logo.

This Los Angeles Soccer Scoreboard works for teams in MLS, the NWSL, the Premier League, Liga MX, LaLiga, Bundesliga, Serie A and Ligue 1.

Setting up your Los Angeles Soccer Scoreboard

Setup takes about a minute: scan the code on the screen, choose your Wi-Fi and your teams. Change teams any time from your phone without setting up Wi-Fi again. No app, no account, no subscription.

In the box: Sports Meter display, 3D-printed desk stand, USB-C cable, quick-start card.

Good to know: Needs 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi. Scores usually trail the live action by well under a minute. Updates itself over Wi-Fi.
